mapper.select: SELECT like_count FROM post WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like pl INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = pl.post_id WHERE pl.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.slug, p.title, p.summary, p.content, p.content_format AS contentFormat, p.created_by AS authorUserId, pf.display_name AS authorName, pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, c.slug AS categorySlug, c.description AS categoryDescription, c.deleted AS categoryDeleted, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime, p.status, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount FROM post_like pl INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = pl.post_id INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE pl.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.published_at IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY pl.created_at DESC, pl.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
